surprises.head: San Jose won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured St. Louis, 4.0 to 2.5, with empty nets left out. A. Nedeljkovic stopped 1.9 more goals than expected.

surprises.head: San Jose tried a different line
surprises.body: I. Chernyshov, M. Marchment, W. Smith played 11:27 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of San Jose’s usual lines.
